question: The median of the observations 76, 83, 30, 11, 81, 52, 18, 34, 84, 35 and 27 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an odd number of observations (n = 11), the median is simply the exact middle value when sorted.

We only need to find the 6th smallest number without sorting the entire sequence.

Identifying smallest to 6th term: 11, 18, 27, 30, 34, 35.

The 6th value is 35.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 76, 83, 30, 11, 81, 52, 18, 34, 84, 35, 27

Total number of observations (n) = 11

**Formula Used:**

When the number of observations (n) is odd, Median = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th observation

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, arrange the given observations in ascending order:

⇒ 11, 18, 27, 30, 34, 35, 52, 76, 81, 83, 84
